title: blob.rs uses crate::client::JmapClient::check_auth_status instead of Self::
description: In blob.rs lines 141 and 226, check_auth_status is called as crate::client::JmapClient::check_auth_status(status) from within an impl JmapClient block. Inside an impl block, Self:: is the idiomatic reference; it is shorter, more resilient to type renames, and clearer to readers that this is a method on the same type. Clippy::use_self catches this.
